aggregation.temporal_coverage: report covered_h, legal_h, coverage_fraction and n_valid_intervals; preserve accepted >=1 legal valid interval eligibility with no new arbitrary stage-duration coverage threshold

primary_family.inference: two-sided one-sample t test of mean same-SID difference=0; df=n_pairs-1; BH across exactly 18 raw adjacent contrasts. Percentile bootstrap CIs are separate from analytic P values. Do not merge H4/old E1/P1-P5 families. Adjusted/anomaly comparisons descriptive effect/CI, no additional stars or significance claims.

bootstrap.unit: original SID, retaining all stage/variable rows together
bootstrap.plan: one fixed 2000 x 2368 multinomial multiplicity bank over sorted original SIDs; target-specific finite/support masks applied inside each replicate; no redraw on a failed target. Existing accepted 24 stage CI rows keep their original seed20260920 and provenance.
bootstrap.interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of valid predeclared draws; report attempted/valid/failed and reasons. No overwrite of old draws; no seed selection by effects.

geographic_adjustment.summary: one row per SID per side; environment and all included covariates averaged over exactly the same valid legal intervals for that variable and model scheme; show raw matched estimate again on that model support.
geographic_adjustment.pair_covariates: after-minus-before differences of the five geographic/seasonal summaries; original genesis-basin and period factors describe heterogeneous adjacent-stage contrasts. No raw longitude subtraction across dateline.
geographic_adjustment.fixed_model: delta_environment ~ 1 + delta_geo_seasonal + C(basin_genesis) + C(period), ordinary least squares with one equal-weight pair per original SID; drop exactly constant/redundant nuisance columns in fixed order, retain target intercept.
geographic_adjustment.support_rule: within each variable and adjacent-stage pair, compute each endpoint distribution 5th/95th covariate quantiles; intersect the two central ranges. Keep only complete pairs whose two endpoints fall within every shared continuous range. Keep basin/period levels represented in both stages. Store all ranges, original/retained n, membership, reasons, and phase-specific empirical distributions. This is an explicit marginal-support restriction, not proof of full joint overlap.
geographic_adjustment.standardization_target: for each retained SID use its own two-stage covariate midpoint for both stages; basin and period stay that SID's actual values. In the additive paired-difference model this is delta_geo_seasonal=0; average predictions over the retained empirical SID mix. No single global four-stage covariate mean and no claim of causal intervention.
geographic_adjustment.estimability_gate: require at least30 retained SID pairs and full-rank identifiable target; report condition number, residual df, leverage, each basin/period count, and whether zero lies within each retained delta covariate range. If zero outside any delta range or target unidentifiable, leave adjusted target NA rather than extrapolate; retain raw restricted target.
geographic_adjustment.target_label: same-SID adjacent-stage contrast standardized for geography and season on stated marginal support

state_adjustment.scheme: separate narrower history-complete stage summaries on the same actual intervals for response and all state covariates; no filled pre-genesis history. Apply same pair-specific central-range rule to continuous state covariates; preserve categorical binary support for contact measures before averaging if useful.
state_adjustment.paired_model: geographic difference model plus differences of wind, age, preceding dv24, current land and past24 land contact; retain each pair observed delta_age in prediction; equalize other covariates as specified below
state_adjustment.interpretation: conditional descriptive comparison in the narrower common measured-state range; not a denial of raw stage differences and not four stages at a universal common intensity. Report original and retained pairs plus raw-on-state-support contrast.
state_adjustment.deterministic_age_warning: chronological stage mean age difference is generally strictly positive. A same-age zero-change target may be outside observed delta support; if so this state target is NA. Prefer a specified observed-age-conditioned contrast or omit age from equalization while retaining age as descriptive support only, subject to root freeze.
state_adjustment.standardization_target: mean_i predict(delta_geo=0, delta_wind=0, delta_dv24=0, delta_land=0, delta_age=observed delta_age_i, basin_i, period_i). Subject to root selection before execution.
state_adjustment.age_rule: Age stays chronological. Report age endpoint ranges and observed delta_age; do not require delta_age=0 or claim same-age comparison. Endpoint central-range eligibility is retained as registered, so this can be a narrow subset.

state_target_recommended_amendment.reason: Equalizing age across successive stages has structural non-overlap; same-SID later stage is always older. It must not be silently extrapolated to delta_age=0.
state_target_recommended_amendment.recommendation: for the state-standardized descriptive target equalize wind, prior24h tendency and land history at pairwise shared-support values; retain each pair's observed delta_age in predictions. Include age in fitted model and audit its endpoint support but do not intervene/equalize age. Standardized predictions retain chronological progression and empirical basin/period mix.
state_target_recommended_amendment.formula: mean_i predict(delta_geo=0, delta_wind=0, delta_dv24=0, delta_land=0, delta_age=observed delta_age_i, basin_i, period_i). Subject to root selection before execution.
